```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", dpi = 300)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

source(here::here("scripts/R/functions/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02", "03", "06", "07"),
  funs = c("model_fun", "calculate_outcomes", "cea_helpers", "report_format"),
  set_knitr = FALSE, set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r build-table, include=FALSE}
basecase <- run_basecase(verbose = FALSE)
icer_df <- as.data.frame(basecase$icer_obj)

display_df <- icer_df %>%
  filter(Strategy %in% names(strategy_labels)) %>%
  mutate(
    Strategy = strategy_labels[Strategy],
    Cost = format_eur(Cost),
    QALYs = sprintf("%.3f", Effect),
    Inc_Cost = format_eur(Inc_Cost),
    Inc_QALYs = ifelse(is.na(Inc_Effect), "--", sprintf("%.3f", Inc_Effect)),
    ICER = format_icer(ICER, Status)
  ) %>%
  select(Strategy, Cost, QALYs, Inc_Cost, Inc_QALYs, ICER, Status)
```

```{r display-table}
kable(
  display_df,
  caption = "Table S5: Full cost-effectiveness results, overall MSS population",
  format = "html",
  col.names = c("Strategy", "Cost", "QALYs", "Incremental Cost",
                "Incremental QALYs", "ICER", "Status"),
  align = c("l", rep("r", 5), "l")
) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12)
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(icer_df, file = here("tables", "table_s5.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

Table S5 has been saved to `tables/table_s5.csv`.
